🎬 Vikings: Valhalla (2022–2024)

Vikings: Valhalla follows a new generation of legendary Norse warriors as they fight for power, survival, and glory during the final years of the Viking Age. Set more than a century after the events of Vikings, the series introduces Leif Erikson, a fearless explorer from Greenland whose extraordinary courage and fighting abilities earn him recognition among powerful Viking leaders. Alongside him is his determined sister, Freydís Eiríksdóttir, who embarks on a personal journey of revenge, faith, and self-discovery while becoming an influential figure among followers of the old Norse religion. Meanwhile, ambitious Norwegian prince Harald Sigurdsson dreams of claiming a throne and establishing his legacy as one of history’s greatest Viking kings. As tensions between Christian and pagan Vikings intensify, political rivalries and religious conflicts threaten to divide their people. Across England, Scandinavia, and distant territories, the characters become involved in dangerous battles, royal conspiracies, unexpected alliances, and ambitious expeditions that shape their futures. From brutal battlefield confrontations and dramatic betrayals to emotional relationships and remarkable voyages, each adventure challenges their loyalty, courage, and determination. As powerful kingdoms compete for control and the Viking world begins changing, Leif, Freydís, and Harald must decide what sacrifices they are willing to make for their beliefs and ambitions. Combining spectacular action sequences, historical drama, compelling characters, and breathtaking landscapes, the series explores honor, faith, revenge, leadership, loyalty, exploration, and the lasting legacy of Viking civilization.

🎭 Genre: Historical Drama • Action • Adventure • War

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 45–60 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Jeb Stuart

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix. Availability varies by region.

source_details.title: Vikings: Valhalla
source_details.synopsis: Vikings: Valhalla, or simply Valhalla, is a historical drama television series created by Jeb Stuart for Netflix that serves as a sequel to Vikings. The eight-episode first season premiered on February 25, 2022. With a 24-episode order announced in November 2019, the series was renewed for a second and third season in March 2022. The second season premiered on January 12, 2023. The third and final season premiered on July 11, 2024.
